description.text: Got questions about booking, move-in, or life at Dwell? We've got answers. If you don't see yours here, just reach out.

answer.text: Yes, fully refundable if you cancel before move-in, minus any standard processing fees.

items.question: How long are the lease terms?

answer.text: We keep it flexible: 3-month minimum stays, with standard 6 and 12 month leases also available.

items.question: Are utilities included in the rent?

answer.text: Yes. Water, electricity, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to all shared amenities are included, no surprise bills.

items.question: Can I schedule a tour before applying?

answer.text: Of course. Book a self-guided or in-person tour directly from any room listing, completely free, no commitment.

items.question: What documents do I need to apply?

answer.text: Just a valid ID, proof of income or enrollment, and a payment method for the deposit. Most applications take under 10 minutes.

items.question: What happens if I need to move out early?

answer.text: Reach out to our team as soon as possible, we offer lease transfer and early termination options depending on your plan.
